what: Cross-device check of the Kaggle T4 fp16 resident capture (notebook v5) against the existing RTX 3050 bf16 capture, same 20 TRAIN decisions (manifest positions 0-19), plus the full v5 smoke summary
source: smoke_results.tar.gz (28.2 MB, downloaded from Kaggle notebooke37bb78765 scriptVersionId 354709171, extracted to tmp/t4smoke); command: tools/t4_vs_3050_cosine.py tmp/t4smoke/out/smoke_gated/train; 3050 files data/v3/capture/train/00000..00019

v5_smoke_summary_read_from_kaggle_output.verdict_by_registered_rule: FEASIBLE but no gain over the 3050 (<=10 s): stay on the 3050

cosine_t4_fp16_vs_3050_bf16.option_vectors_below_0.999: 4 of 2859 (0.140 %), all in one file (00010-4db890fe.pt, 4 of its 249), worst 0.99891

pass_A_vs_pass_B: bit-identical in all 20 files (query and options), i.e. the gate cadence does not change the stored states
output_size_fix: the Output tab of v5 lists no qwen3-4b folder (v4 output was 8.09 GB); exact size not read
caveats: bf16 on the 3050 and fp16 on the T4 differ in rounding; neither is ground truth
all roles must be captured on one device class and dtype (CLAUDE.md), so this check does not make mixing T4 and 3050 states acceptable
